title: We miss you, regular guests
description: Invite past regulars back with a small incentive. Re-engagement WhatsApp template for restaurants and cafes. Free to copy and edit.
notes: Segment guests who have not visited in 45 days or more. A small, specific perk beats a deep discount.

body.text: We miss you, {{first_name}}! It's been a while since your last visit to {{restaurant}}. Come back this month and enjoy a free coffee with any main.
